title: Cats Dumdum & Mousey in Cluttered Yard, c. 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot capturing two cats, handwritten as Dumdum and Mousey on the reverse, lounging in a cluttered suburban backyard. The felines rest near the shadowed base of a building structure surrounded by an assortment of outdoor items, including a vintage child's pull wagon filled with leaves, a portable space heater, bricks, fencing, and a vintage metal Alemite canister against dense foliage.
